title: 🎨 Paint Your Own Hobbit House
description:
Join local artist Jennifer Devlin for an afternoon of painting your own hobbit house. You'll leave with a finished piece to display at home and a fun afternoon spent creating with others. 

Whether you're an experienced painter or picking up a brush for the first time, Jennifer will guide you every step of the way in a relaxed, welcoming environment.
Spend the afternoon slowing down, getting creative, and connecting with fellow makers as you bring your tiny home to life.
Your ticket includes:
🎨 Guided instruction from Jennifer Devlin
🏡 One hobbit house canvas to paint and take home
🖌️ All materials included
✨ A fun, creative experience with fellow adventurers
No painting experience is necessary—just bring your imagination and we'll take care of the rest!

Participants must be 16+.
